This PR, which you wrote, adds CSV export for widgets; robin and acme/reviewers are also requested as reviewers. It covers the CSV download and the header format, defers scheduled exports to acme/widgets#46, deliberately buffers the whole file instead of streaming it, leaves the export screen to acme/export-ui, and production export speed can only be checked after merge.

Two problems block merging, and a required check is still running:

1. The exporter writes rows without the header line, so a downloaded file has no column names. The test export_header fails when run on this machine (src/export.ts:31).
2. The export guide says exports run nightly, but the button exports on demand, so readers will expect a file that never arrives. A corrected sentence is drafted (docs/export.md:8).

maria pointed out the missing header in a PR comment, and she is right; the drafted reply agrees and says a fix is coming (comment-73). Your earlier review had three points, and this version addresses two of them. The branch was rebased onto main before this review, with one conflict in src/export.ts resolved along the way. One smaller point does not block merging: the export loop repeats the shared paging helper's code (src/export.ts:44), and deliver with nits can take it.

I recommend deliver because both problems have drafted repairs and this is your PR.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - the same, and also replace the repeated paging loop with the shared helper.
3. assess - post the two problems to the PR as one review and make no repairs.
4. stop - remove the PR worktree if it holds no unpushed work, and leave the PR as it is.
